parts.answer: One complete sinusoidal oscillation from $(0,5)$, initially downwards, through minimum $(\frac{\pi}{4},3)$ and maximum $(\frac{3\pi}{4},7)$, ending at $(\pi,5)$.

SR A1A0: $0.583\pi$ or $0.917\pi$; $1.83c$ or $2.88c$.
